title: Unified 6-Level UI Surface System
description: Replace the dual Level (base|canvas|window|panel|overlay|temporary) + GlassTier (panel|ribbon|menu|windowOptions) systems with a single formula-derived 6-level system: base -> window -> pane -> panel -> dialog -> menu. Each level's background darkens (light mode) / lightens (dark mode) and its glass (blur+alpha) increases, derived from base knobs via oklab color-mix, not hand-tuned. No element manually assigns fill/glass -- everything inherits from data-level CSS cascade. Applies across ui/js/react, ui/styling, the OS shell (framework/renderer/react), coda desktop/assistant, cad/renderer, infinite, animate, legacy compose apps, Storybook, and the native wgpu mirror (ui/wgpu/rs, framework/renderer/wgpu/rs). Full design in /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/all-ui-elements-are-fizzy-shore.md.
